newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA SIGN PORTUGUESE DEFENDER HUGO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA SIGN PORTUGUESE DEFENDER HUGO.

text.p: Italy's Sampdoria said on Thursday they had signed Portuguese defender Miguel Fernandez Vieira Hugo from Sporting Braga for a reported fee of around $2.0 million.
Hugo, 20, who had also been targetted by Spanish champions Real Madrid, agreed a four-year contract with the serie A club.
He will probably play at centre-back but said he also liked the role of sweeper.
"My model is (German) Matthias Sammer," he told reporters in this northern Italian city after signing the new contract.
